origin_requirement: All class addresses and Game/Core/CoreLib image origins must come from fresh loaded assembly hashes plus cached class metadata/layout capture on the authorized current process. The business layer checks exact image/token identities and uses View.StaticReference to revalidate initialized static storage, field type/slot and singleton pointers. No saved address is an origin.

integer_contract.role_id_and_config_id: positive int32, exact equality without normalization
integer_contract.creature_data_id: positive int64 JSON integer, preserved above JS safe integer limit
integer_contract.group_type: present Nullable<ETeamGroupType> from both player and model, exact equality, known -1..4; Default=0 is valid
integer_contract.living_state: recorded known 0..2; Alive is a later display policy, not a roster filter

business_chain: Read existing PlayerInfoModel._Instance, SceneTeamModel._Instance, CharacterModel._Instance, ObjectSystem._instance; reject null or uninitialized storage without getter.
PlayerInfoModel.Id -> TeamPlayerMap[pid], check player.PlayerId; present player/model CurrentGroupType -> GroupMap[group], check group PlayerId and GroupType.
RoleList exactly three nonnull distinct object references with positive distinct CreatureDataId/RoleId; CurrentRole must be one of those same references.

Enumerate bounded TeamItems, filter by PlayerId first, require exactly three local items and IsMyRoleInternal/group agreement; exact (RoleId==ConfigId,CreatureDataId) bijection, output RoleList order.
CurrentItem must be the exact matched local item for CurrentRole. Read only EntityHandleInternal cached reference, reject missing, PendingRemoving or CID mismatch.
Handle.Id/index -> CharacterModel.Handles[index] same handle reference; require initialized verified derived WorldEntity parent chain to Game WorldEntity then Core Entity/ObjectBase.
Read Id/Index under Core ObjectBase field_scope and FlagInternal under Core Entity field_scope; require handle/entity Id/index equality and init bit0x10 without clear bit0x80.
ObjectSystem.Objects[index] same entity reference and Versions[index]==Id&65535. Sparse access only requested slots with validated list counts/headers.
View.Revalidate compares all observed static, metadata, object, collection and field bytes before returning. One cached View is one observation, not two frames.

The caller must create fresh View captures in two strictly increasing engine frames, compare StableIdentity and complete the independent native/current-Pawn join. Display requires its own policy and user visual confirmation/restoration.

strict_idle_policy.limitation: This is a conservative initial capture policy. ChangingRoleTime may retain an expired nonzero timestamp until the game getter clears it; the reader never calls the getter or clears fields. FinishSeamlessUpdateTeam directly clears IsSeamlessUpdateTeam and SeamlessUpdateTeamStartTime, so the zero seamless timestamp check follows the observed finish lifecycle but is still a capture policy rather than proof of all possible writers.

seamless_finish_evidence.il: 0..2 stfld IsSeamlessUpdateTeam=false; 7..10 stfld SeamlessUpdateTeamStartTime=0; 23..25 clears IsSeamlessUpdateTeamBlockInput when set. Saved IL evidence only, not executed by the reader.

subtype_policy: WorldEntity is not sealed. Derived runtime classes are accepted only when View validates initialized current metadata/layout and an acyclic bounded parent chain to each exact required base class. Field lookup always uses explicit declared field_scope; shadow fields cannot replace Core identity.
witness: Independent csharp_witness contains roots, current refs, collections/counts, transition fields, declared/runtime class scopes, handle/object slot agreement, raw entity flags and View revalidation evidence. It never supplies or impersonates V8 source witnesses.

fixture_validation.scope: Invented typed View checks business invariants and revalidation dependency; no game process access or runtime invocation. This fixture does not validate Mono physical offsets. Existing mono_managed_readonly_fixture is separately responsible for the real byte-level View.
